solution.approach: Verified Answer: **15.75** ($z = 15.75 \approx 15.75$).
solution.keyConcept: Same Base Power Law: B^{p·z} = B^{q·k} ⇒ z = (q × k) / p

optionTrick.en: Ignore dummy base 86! Directly equate exponents: $0.2z = 0.35 \times 9 = 3.15 \Rightarrow z = 3.15 / 0.2 \approx 15.75$.
optionTrick.hi: डमी आधार 86 को छोड़ें! सीधे घात बराबर करें: $0.2z = 0.35 \times 9 \Rightarrow z \approx 15.75$।

title.hi: विधि 1: आधार समान कर घातों की तुलना

steps.en:
Substitute $x = 86^{0.2}$ and $y = 86^{0.35}$ into $x^z = y^{9}$:
$86^{0.2z} = 86^{0.35 \times 9} = 86^{3.15}$.
Since bases are equal, $0.2z = 3.15 \Rightarrow z = \frac{3.15}{0.2} = 15.7500 \approx \mathbf{15.75}$.

title.en: Method 2: Direct Ratio Exponent Formula (`4 sec`)

solution.en:
Method 1: Base Substitution & Exponent Equating: Substitute $x = 86^{0.2}$ and $y = 86^{0.35}$ into $x^z = y^{9}$:
$86^{0.2z} = 86^{0.35 \times 9} = 86^{3.15}$.
Since bases are equal, $0.2z = 3.15 \Rightarrow z = \frac{3.15}{0.2} = 15.7500 \approx \mathbf{15.75}$.

Method 2: Direct Ratio Exponent Formula (`4 sec`): Ratio of exponents $0.35 : 0.2 = 7 : 4$ ⇒ $z = \frac{7 \times 9}{4} = 15.750 \approx \mathbf{15.75}$.
solution.hi:
विधि 1: आधार समान कर घातों की तुलना: $x = 86^{0.2}$ व $y = 86^{0.35}$ को $x^z = y^{9}$ में रखें:
$86^{0.2z} = 86^{3.15} \Rightarrow 0.2z = 3.15 \Rightarrow z \approx \mathbf{15.75}$।

विधि 2: सीधा अनुपात सूत्र (`4 सेकंड`): सीधा $z = \frac{0.35 \times 9}{0.2} \approx \mathbf{15.75}$।

question.en: Mukesh, a trader, buys a certain number of pens at ₹5 per pen. He sells two-thirds of the pens at a 25% profit and the remaining pens at a 10% loss. If the overall profit made by Mukesh is ₹360, how many pens did he buy?
question.hi: व्यापारी मुके श ₹5 प्रति पेन की दर से कु छ पेन खरीदता है। वह दो - तिहाई पेन 25% लाभ पर और शेष पेन 10% हानि पर बेचता है। यदि मुके श का कु ल लाभ ₹360 है , तो बताएं कि उसने कितने पेन खरीदे थे ?

solution.approach: Official Answer: Option D (**540**).

steps.en:
Total CP $= 3x \times 5 = 15x$. Profit on `2x` $= 10x(0.25) = +2.5x$; Loss on `x` $= -0.5x$.
Net Profit $= 2x = 360 \implies x = 180 \implies 3x =$ **540 pens**!

solution.en:
Method 1: Let Total Pens = 3x: Total CP $= 3x \times 5 = 15x$. Profit on `2x` $= 10x(0.25) = +2.5x$; Loss on `x` $= -0.5x$.
Net Profit $= 2x = 360 \implies x = 180 \implies 3x =$ **540 pens**!

Method 2: Weighted Rate 40/3 % = ₹360 (5 sec): Net Profit `% = (2×25 − 1×10) / 3 = 40/3 %` (`= 2/15` of Total CP) `= ₹360`.
Total CP $= 360 \times \frac{15}{2} = 2700 \implies$ Pens $= 2700 \div 5 =$ **540**!
